scope: Offline validated graph-to-directory export of a user-owned Frosty sphere, followed by GPU AABB generation and original primitive mapping. No game bytes are distributed. This is not a runtime provider path or full shader 219 execution.
graph: The existing conservative validator checks structure, reachable nodes, graph bounds and containment before export. The exporter walks only types 0/4/5, emits both paired leaf sides, and matches each geometry/primitive ID to a unique CPU decoder triangle. Unsupported, clipped or shared-leaf cases are rejected.
gpu_checks: GPU kernels read the GPU-copied body and directory, generate one AABB and geometry/primitive/leaf/side mapping per candidate. Readback compares every mapping against the CPU decoder and requires each generated AABB to strictly enclose all three CPU-decoded vertices.
limits: One observed sphere asset and one set of vertices; the directory decoder and GPU tests do not establish coverage of other assets, node types or spatial splits.
Bounds are not used to build an acceleration structure in this sphere-wide check. The separate synthetic paired control exercises BLAS/TLAS building and ray queries.
No queue-ordered runtime publication, guest descriptor association, resource lifetime, shader 219 execution, full numerical equivalence or fail-closed live dispatch is established.
